data.revised_prompt:
Create a clean 2D game FX sprite sheet, exactly 2 rows by 2 columns, four animation frames in a square grid. Use the provided guide image only as a layout reference for cell placement, spacing, and centering; do not include any guide lines, borders, labels, or safe-area marks in the final image. The entire canvas background outside the FX should be solid #FF00FF (pure magenta). Each frame must be centered in its cell, consistent scale, contained within the central 65% of each cell, with nothing crossing cell edges.

Frame 1 (top-left): a small star-shaped yellow-white spark, sharp and compact, with subtle glow.
Frame 2 (top-right): a jagged lightning rip tearing across the center, bright white/yellow core with orange glow, dynamic angular shape.
Frame 3 (bottom-left): an explosive starburst of short angular sparks, bright white center, yellow edges, energetic and crisp.
Frame 4 (bottom-right): fading zigzag sparks and tiny ember points, dimmer than prior frames, with a few orange/yellow remnants.

Style: clean HD arcade card-game effect, high contrast, readable at small card size, effect only, no playing card, no UI, no text, no icons, no extra objects. Sharp edges, polished particle glow, consistent visual language across frames.
